RAPID is a prototyping blueprint, not production software. Changes that keep it
simple, fast to deploy and easy to read are preferred over changes that add
production hardening, abstraction layers or configuration surface. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the conventions this repository
follows.

Please search open and recently closed issues before opening a new request.

## Problem

What you are trying to do, and what makes it hard or impossible today.

## Proposed change

What you would like the repository to do instead. If it is a configuration
change, name the `config.yaml` keys involved; if it is an infrastructure change,
name the construct under `infra/lib/constructs/`.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways of solving the same problem, including doing it in your own fork.

## Scope

- [ ] This changes documentation only
- [ ] This changes `config.yaml` or the configuration loader
- [ ] This changes the synthesized infrastructure
- [ ] This adds or changes an agent or an MCP server

## Are you willing to open a pull request?

Yes / No. Either answer is fine — knowing helps with prioritization.
